correctness.rationale: Binary order-five de Bruijn cycles are independently enumerated as Eulerian cycles of the order-four de Bruijn graph and by length-five-factor backtracking rooted at the unique factor 00000. The complete sets coincide and have 2048 elements. Prefix-range and direct circular-factor discrepancy implementations agree on every cycle, yielding exactly 224,688,912,224 cycles at discrepancies 5,6,7,8. Complement/reversal orbit recomputation gives 60 minimizer orbits with sizes 2:8 and 4:52.

value.rationale: The complete distribution over all de Bruijn sequences was explicitly identified as a future direction in the 2022 discrepancy paper, while the 2024 breakthrough settles only the minimum value and provides an optimal construction. The order-five census is the first nontrivial full layer with 2048 cycles and quantifies both how abundant the newly characterized minimizers are and how they organize under the natural complement/reversal symmetries.
